name: Cairnspine Linnorm - Young
description: Young Cairnspine is a chaotic, instinct-driven worldborn linnorm clever, wingless, non-humanoid linnorm with granite-coloured scales and high slate spines. It seeks to keep mountain slopes stable through controlled rockfalls. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Stonebreaking Jaws
attacks.description: The linnorm strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The linnorm can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Cliff-Grip
abilities.description: The linnorm climbs sheer rock without slowing and cannot be knocked from a cliff by ordinary movement.

abilities.name: Concussive Roar
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 15. On a failure, take 2d8+4 physical damage and the target is knocked back to Close range by gravel and slate. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the linnorm marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
